## Mod and behaviour

Describe the change, public SDK functions/hooks used, and known limitations.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] Targets `devel`; source only, licence and README included.
- [ ] No binaries, archives, encoded blobs, game material, keys or saves.
- [ ] Original art has a reproducible readable generator.
- [ ] No generated catalogue URL/hash/size edits.
- [ ] Listed every setup tool and imported helper; no network/process execution or writes outside mod data.
- [ ] Listed hooks/replacements and file/input/HUD services.
- [ ] Reported USA/EU, Metal/Vulkan, 30/60 fps, state/save and disabled-mod verification, or clearly identified missing checks.
